name: twin_per_band
caption: Twin-seed contrast per turnover band. `d_twin` is the mean cosine distance between twin members at the same stochastic seed; `d_control` is same-seed different-stochastic distance among those members; `delta` is their difference with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI.
alt_text: Twin-seed contrast per turnover band. `d_twin` is the mean cosine distance between twin members at the same stochastic seed; `d_control` is same-seed different-stochastic distance among those members; `delta` is their difference with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI.
limitations: A last-band CI excluding 0 from above means the factual flip still shapes the locked trajectory; it is not a semantic basin and not an MSM macrostate. Crossed twin pairs (different stochastic seeds) are excluded from both sides of Δ. Pairs stay inside one (W, T).
